decisions.decision: Commission agreed to correct its August-approved determination of applicability to show the address as One Main Street rather than Three Main Street, since no Three Main Street exists in town assessors' records.
Commission agreed it would support relocating the current town green gazebo, noting it is not historic and citing traffic and parking concerns, for input to the master plan steering committee.

Commission agreed to tell the master plan steering committee it supports reuse and opposes demolition of the Brooks House, while demolition of the TC Pacios building would be acceptable in exchange for increased density in a town center redevelopment.

what_happened.line: The commission approved new shutters and a rooftop cupola at One Main Street, the Bad Larry's/Hilltop Farms building.
It also corrected an August-approved determination of applicability, changing the address on record from Three Main Street to One Main Street.
Members worked through a master plan steering committee questionnaire on a proposed town green and town center redevelopment, favoring relocation of the current green's gazebo.
They indicated support for reusing rather than demolishing the Brooks House, while saying demolition of the TC Pacios building would be acceptable in exchange for greater density.
No formal vote on the questionnaire answers was captured before the recording appears to end.

why_it_matters: The approved determination lets exterior changes proceed at a Main Street commercial building without further commission review.

The gazebo, Brooks House and TC Pacios positions are informal input toward a master plan steering committee questionnaire, not a binding decision, and will help shape a future town center development plan.
Residents following the town green or town center discussion should know these positions were discussed, not voted on, at this meeting.
